calls.title: Lululemon Stock: A Once-in-a-Decade Opportunity?
calls.thesis: Fairly valued at ~$100 after 80% drawdown; EPS guided down to <$9 (-30% this year); zero debt + $1.4B net cash, but buybacks done at high prices destroyed value; buy limit ~$74 with margin of safety
calls.bull: Fair value ~$200 (~$150 with margin of safety) on 9%/8% EPS growth
calls.bear: Fair value ~$36 (-65%) if EPS declines 10%/yr for 5 years
